column1: # Cases whose difference from their golden a departure explains: vtium does
# what the C reference did not, and a crate's README lists it under
# "## Departures". Each line names VARIANTS and SCREENS (comma-separated;
# every pair is a case), the README, the departure's bold title exactly as
# the README gives it, and the rectangles x0,y0,x1,y1 (end-exclusive, ";"
# between) the difference must lie in. A listed case that differs only
# there is a "departure", which passes; one that differs elsewhere, or no
